name: cadenya
description: Build, run, and manage AI agents on Cadenya, the hosted agent runtime, with Cadenya Skills and the Cadenya MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Build and run agents on Cadenya
interface.longDescription: Create Tool Sets and Agents, run and stream objectives, approve tool calls, and embed Agents in web apps with Widgets on Cadenya, the hosted agent runtime. Includes Skills for the Cadenya API, CLI, and TypeScript, Go, Python, and Ruby SDKs, Widgets, and starting without an account, plus the hosted Cadenya MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Set up a Cadenya Agent with an MCP Tool Set and run an objective
Write Cadenya config files for my Agents and apply them
Stream a Cadenya objective's events and approve its tool calls
